title: FragmentSender::fragment_at_position has implicit ALL_1 mapping
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:672-680

Issue: The function maps position 62 to ALL_1 fragments via a special case:
```rust
&& if fragment.is_all_1() {
    position == 62
} else {
    position == 62 - fragment.fcn
}
```

This hardcodes the assumption that ALL_1 fragments occupy 'position 62' in the window's bit space. The mapping is:
- Regular FCN 62 → position 0
- Regular FCN 1 → position 61
- ALL_1 (FCN 63) → position 62

Impact: The position==62 special case is fragile if WINDOW_SIZE or the ALL_1 mapping ever changes. Additionally, this duplicates knowledge that exists elsewhere (fragment_bit function at line 684).

Suggested fix: Extract the position-to-fragment mapping logic to a single source of truth, or add a comment explaining the position encoding scheme.
